description: Review of the commit that replaced the hand-written scope resolver with the languages' own tooling: `const [omit = t.skip.bind(t)] = []` gives `omit` a default that contains the test context's `skip` (the context is an origin like a runner import), and `omit()` calls it: at least a WARN, never silence; the `t.skip` the definition adds is a WARN of its own. The real runner skips the test.
